text_block_list.text:
With the early summer wind blowing past, 
Red Desire arrived early at Tokyo 
Racecourse and quietly looked down at the 
turf.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—The flow of mana is exceptionally smooth. 
My heart is clearer than it has ever been.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san. Today, once again, I shall race 
across this turf.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"In order to aim for even greater heights 
than the moments I ran with you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, have faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Witness the majesty of Saint Red Desire, 
conquering each and every ordeal—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan. It's been a while since we 
faced each other on the track, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... I have never forgotten those 
days I ran alongside you, nor that fiery 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because of that Classic 
year I raced through with you... that I am 
who I am today."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Today, the one who will wage a fierce 
battle with you is me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the eyes of determination. A 
far stronger... will than back then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
But you know. I've grown much stronger 
than I was back then, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, faster than 
Desire-chan... Faster than anyone else, 
I'll reach that "breathtaking view"!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's this dazzling brilliance... It 
brings back the heat of the turf I ran 
with you...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Those days spent running in search of a 
sight no one had ever seen before—...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Having stepped up into the Senior Year, 
countless strong rivals stand before us, 
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am honored that you continue to look at 
me just as you always have.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do. After all, we're comrades, 
aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Exactly so.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"'Not someone else's, but your own! With 
these legs! With this soul! Only those who 
run to the very end——'"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"We'll reach a badass world that nobody's 
ever seen before!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"For that moment when one's soul is truly 
fulfilled, and knocks upon the door to 
another world—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With these legs that belong to nobody 
else... I will give this trial everything 
I have!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...O Heaven, O Earth, and all the spirits 
gathered upon this land."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Saint Red Desire now descends upon this 
grand stage—with unyielding, resolute 
determination."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: These legs no longer belong to me alone.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The souls entrusted, the burning desires, 
the great expectations— converting all of 
it into pure acceleration—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Further ahead than anyone else!

Casting aside all doubt, Red Desire gazes 
upon the turf with resolute eyes. The 
Saint's new trial begins now—!
